purpose: Correct an imbalance in the merged audit (PR #1294): bounded slots did NOT fail. They produced the only demonstrated long-range retrieval improvement in the internal matched experiments, with clean causal evidence. The limitation is scope and stability, not efficacy.
evidence_source: experiments/phase_lc/results/abc.json (1200 steps, batch 16, N=160 train / 256 eval, 3 seeds [0,1,2]); experiments/phase_lc/REPORT_ABC.md

demonstrated.claim: bounded slots improved long-range single-fact retrieval at the tested scale
demonstrated.evidence: C-arm needle@d96 mean 0.156 vs A/B ~0.00; seed-0 0.4667 (chance ~0.02). abc.json C records; REPORT_ABC.md:96

demonstrated.claim: the positive result was causally attributable to slots
randomizing slot addresses removed the capability
removing Phase did NOT remove the slot-based result
demonstrated.evidence: phase_off needle@d96 seed0 unchanged at 0.475. abc.json:421; the learned addressable memory, not Phase, carried it

demonstrated.claim: the slot mechanism operated without global sequence-quadratic attention
demonstrated.evidence: no_nxn_check.slots_builds_NN = false in every abc.json record; models.py:200 uses cumsum over M slots, no [N,N]

demonstrated.claim: slot memory remained bounded with respect to sequence length
demonstrated.evidence: resources.slot_state_floats_per_layer = 16384 (32 slots x 128 x 4 layers = 16384), independent of N; total bounded state C = 16896 floats

not_yet_demonstrated_robustly.evidence: needle@d96 per seed 0.4667 / 0.000 / 0.000 -> forms in 1 of 3 seeds
C current_acc 0.025, stale_error 0.036 ~ chance (learned model; the MECHANISM supports it — see stdlib reference tests)

prose_only_not_reproducible.status: NOT_FOUND as any saved artifact (prose-only in REPORT_ABC.md:75,99,176,228)
prose_only_not_reproducible.action: the reproduction target is the SAVED 1200-step per-seed numbers, not the 1.00 prose figure; the 1.00 claim is explicitly excluded from the reproduction gate

mechanism_vs_learning_boundary: The DISCRETE slot mechanics (addressing, supersession+version, source retention, LRU eviction, bounded state, no N x N) are reproduced deterministically by the stdlib reference (hybrid_llm_vnext_lab, 36 tests pass). Whether SGD learns the projections that realize these capabilities under training is the separate neural question — partially demonstrated (single-fact, 1/3 seeds), otherwise not-yet, and RESOURCE_BLOCKED to re-run here (no torch).
